hall.title: INDUSTRY PARTNERS
hall.subtitle: Aviation and travel partners, all under one roof at Sunfield.

stellar.name: Sunfield Terminal
stellar.blurb: The front door of Sunfield: fuel, hangar, ground services, a crew lounge and concierge, all at one desk.
contact: Ask for me at the stand by the hall
greet: Welcome to Sunfield. You are standing in the terminal.
Fuel, hangar and ground services, all at one desk.
Flying in? We look after the aircraft, the crew and you.

talk.t: I'm Dale Calder, I manage the Sunfield Terminal. This whole building is the terminal, and we look after every aircraft, crew and passenger that comes through it. What would you like to know?
o: Where can I fly from here?

talk.t: An FBO, a fixed base operator, is the front door of an airfield for private aviation: fuel, ramp and overnight parking, hangar space, a crew lounge and flight planning room, concierge, rental cars and ground transport. When a jet lands here, we look after the aircraft, the crew and the passengers.

Right here. Fuel, hangar space, ground services, the crew lounge and concierge all run through this desk, with fueling out on the ramp by Gate A2. The hangar homes and the Flight Line of Genesis stay fuel free.
Nonstops leave Gate A2 for Los Angeles, Dallas, Chicago and Denver, and the boards inside list the rest. Wherever you land, we look after you the same way.
Ask for me at the desk any time. My details are on this card; you can select and copy them.

Everything a flight needs, under one roof. Arrivals and check-in are inside the doors, the crew lounge and flight planning room sit beside this stand, and concierge can arrange cars and ground transport across Genesis. Out on the ramp we handle fuel, hangar space and ground services. The terminal looks after the aviation side of Sunfield, from the moment a jet lands to the moment it leaves.

jetfinders.name: Tailwind Jets
jetfinders.blurb: One advisor for all your flying: on-demand charter, jet cards, fractional ownership, aircraft sales and management, and hangars on the Flight Line.
contact: Ask at the Tailwind Jets stand
Quotes at the desk, any time
greet: Charter, jet cards, hangars. Ask me anything.
Thinking about a hangar home? Start here.

talk.t: I'm Jake with Tailwind Jets: one advisor for all your flying, with thousands of aircraft to choose from, worldwide. What can I help with?
o: How do I reach Tailwind Jets?

talk.t: On-demand charter, jet cards, fractional ownership, aircraft sales and management, business and specialty flights such as helicopter and medical, hangars and hangar homes, and trip and crew planning.
o: How do I reach Tailwind Jets?

talk.t: Tailwind Jets is the aviation partner for Genesis: charters in and out of Sunfield, owners' aircraft at home on the Flight Line, and hangars and hangar homes with their own taxiway access. Captain Reyes flies with us; you'll find him out on the apron by Gate A2.
o: How do I reach Tailwind Jets?

talk.t: A jet card is a block of flying hours you book ahead, so an aircraft is ready when you are, with the same crew standards on every trip. Ask me and I'll walk you through how it works.
o: How do I reach Tailwind Jets?

talk.t: Ask me here at the stand and I'll come back to you with options. The details are on this card.

freedomair.name: Open Range Air
freedomair.blurb: Private jet charter and aircraft management, positioning aircraft right here at Sunfield.

npc.name: Joe
npc.role: Open Range Air · private jet charter

contact: Empty legs posted at the desk
greet: Need a jet positioned on the runway? Ask me.
Empty legs this week. Ask me what's open.

talk.t: I'm Joe, and this is Beth. Welcome to Open Range Air. We run private jet charter and aircraft management, and we position aircraft right here at Sunfield. Where are you headed?
Challenger 300, Citation X, Citation XLS, CJ3+, Epic E1000 and a Pilatus PC-12, plus an Airbus EC130 helicopter for tours. West Coast, East Coast and the Caribbean.
Empty legs are one-way repositioning flights, offered when an aircraft has to fly that way anyway. Ask and we'll tell you what's open this week.
Ask at the charter desk, right here, and we'll put a trip together for you. The details are on this card.
